2608.22512.title: HANSARD: A Reference Architecture for Forensic Readiness, Runtime Witnessing, and Graded Attribution in Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Systems
2608.22512.paper_summary: Autonomous multi-agent systems nowadays act in finance, software supply chains, and security operations. Already, the first largely AI-orchestrated intrusion campaigns have been reported. Yet, when such a system causes harm, no method can robustly establish what happened, what caused it, or who is accountable. This is because provenance forensics works at the wrong abstraction, formal causality assumes the causal model, and agent auditing trusts self-recording. The target failure mode is, thus, attribution laundering, i.e., spreading an act across redundant agents until none is a but-for cause. Worse, the record is produced by the suspects, which comprises the assumption adopted throughout this work. Agents may therefore anticipate the investigation and the part of logging infrastructure may itself collude. In this paper, HANSARD is proposed, a reference architecture treating accountability as a life-cycle property. First, a readiness profile sealed before operation bounds what later findings may claim. Second, capturing at five choke points beyond the agents' reach makes omissions detectable, not only tampering. Third, a typed PROV-DM-aligned causal graph accrues as the system runs, and three indicators read it live to gate oversight without adjudicating. Fourth, post-incident replay yields contingent effects under the modified Halpern-Pearl definition, together with a compensation-set size. Finally, a synergy residual measures harm due to the combination rather than to individuals, making laundering visible. Cause, responsibility and accountability are then reported separately, each capped by an evidentiary tier, while a future research agenda is also provided.
2608.22512.paper_summary_zh: 自主多代理系統如今在金融、軟體供應鏈和安全操作中發揮作用。已有報導指出，首批主要由人工智慧協調的入侵活動已經出現。然而，當這樣的系統造成傷害時，沒有任何方法能夠穩健地確定發生了什麼、造成的原因或誰應負責。這是因為來源鑑識在錯誤的抽象層次上運作，形式因果關係假設了因果模型，而代理審核則信任自我記錄。因此，目標失敗模式是歸因洗白，即將行為分散到冗餘的代理中，直到沒有一個是必要原因。更糟的是，記錄是由嫌疑人生成的，這是本研究中採用的假設。因此，代理可能會預見調查，而日誌基礎設施的一部分可能會自我勾結。在本文中，提出了HANSARD，這是一種將問責視為生命週期屬性的參考架構。首先，在操作之前密封的準備檔案界定了後續發現可能聲稱的範圍。其次，在代理無法觸及的五個瓶頸點進行捕捉，使得遺漏可被檢測，而不僅僅是篡改。第三，隨著系統運行，類型化的PROV-DM對齊的因果圖逐漸累積，並且三個指標實時讀取它，以便在不裁決的情況下進行監督。第四，事件後重播根據修改過的Halpern-Pearl定義產生偶然效果，並提供補償集大小。最後，協同殘差衡量由於組合而非個體造成的傷害，使洗白行為變得可見。因果、責任和問責隨後被分別報告，每個報告都受證據層級的限制，同時也提供了未來的研究議程。
